title: Marcos laughs off ‘Anak’ song choice at Apec: ‘Very, very warm gesture’

blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday brushed off speculation over China’s choice of the Filipino song “Anak” for his red-carpet entrance at the gala dinner for Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) leaders, calling it a “very, very warm gesture.” At a press briefing with Philippine media before departing for Manila, the president said those giving malice to the song choice were reading too much into the gesture. For the president, the selection was “terrific” and “great,” describing it as a gracious gesture from China. READ: Why ‘Anak’?
